analogy.rationale: Dopamine receptor agonists act on DRD1-5 and cross-react with serotonin and adrenergic receptors, but these cell lines express little dopamine receptor, so transcriptional responses should be weak; other GPCR-targeting classes acting on shared monoamine pathways may show modest overlap.
